blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).
blocks.zh: 记忆决定了边缘设备运行的LLMS,以及运行的速度:容量为4美元GB Jetson Nano,带宽为8美元GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. 部署格式( GPTQ, AWQ, $\ textt{llama. cpp} $'s K - 和 I - quants) 在矩阵的每个整数代码上花费相等的位数, 尽管代码远非统一 。 $\ textt{LazyWights}$ 保持这些格式,但调用GPTQ,所以代码压缩,Huffman - 在互换行道中将它们无所失失,并在DRAM和L2之间的一个小单元中按需解码,所以GPU内核运行不变,DRAM只移动编码字节. 按1美元和3.5美元计算,代号为Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B和SmolLM-1.7B的数额为5.7-31.4美元,比最好的$\textt{llama.cpp}的$格式要小。 一个略为精确的0.21美元毫米的ASIC解码器单位(1美元GHz,7美元nm)将奥林的空闲时间和能量每象征性地削减了36美元和38美元(54美元和44美元,加上即时猜测). 在纳诺上,$\textt{LazyWights}美元比CPU$\textt{llama.cpp}每枚硬币需要58-64美元少时间,53-57美元少能量,并以3.89美元每重量运行一个流式的Mistral-7B 6.6美元\时速. 一个Huffman解码器以相等的吞吐量在速率和面积上击败一个rANS解码器;ASIC解码器单元在Zynq Ultra Scale+FPGA(AMD ZCU102.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Generating a token reads every weight of a large language model (LLM) once, so on an edge device the weight footprint decides whether a model fits and how fast it runs: a 7B model needs 14 GB in 16-bit floats, more than most edge modules have, and even at 4 bits each token moves gigabytes through a phone-class memory system. llama.cpp [ 1 ] has made post-training quantization the default, with GGUF files offering fixed-width integer formats with per-block scales from 8 down to about 3 bits per weight.
blocks.zh: 生成一个符符读出一个大语言模型(LLM)的每个重量一次,所以在一个边缘设备上,重量脚印决定一个模型是否适合以及运行的速度:一个7B模型在16位浮点中需要14GB,比大多数边缘模块拥有的要多,甚至在4位时,每个符符通过一个电话级内存系统移动千兆字节. lama.cpp [1] 使训练后量化默认值,GGUF文件提供固定的整数格式,每块秤从8个下到每个重量约3位.

blocks.en: These formats and the quantizers that target them (GPTQ [ 2 ] , AWQ [ 3 ] , the llama.cpp K- and I-quants) share an unstated commitment: every code of a matrix costs the same number of bits . This wastes bits twice. Weights are bell-shaped, so a 4-bit alphabet’s inner codes dominate and its entropy sits well below 4 bits [ 4 , 5 ] ; and many code assignments reach the same quality, so a quantizer that knows its codes will be entropy-coded can pick ones that compress.
blocks.zh: 这些格式和针对它们的量子(GPTQ [2], AWQ [3], lama.cpp K-和 I-quants) 共享一个未声明的承诺:每个矩阵代码花费相同的位数. 这浪费了两次 重量是钟形的,因此一个4位字母的内编码占主导地位,其 en位远低于4位[4,5];许多编码任务达到同样的质量,因此一个知道它的编码会是 en位编码的四解码器可以选择压缩的.

blocks.en: Lossless weight coding, from Deep Compression [ 6 ] to recent work on 16-bit LLM weights [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] or a quantizer’s integers [ 11 , 12 ] , takes the quantizer as given and mostly decodes in software. A coded 4-bit model is worth having only if it beats the next-smaller fixed-width format at equal quality, a comparison rarely made, and only if its codes can be expanded at DRAM rate every token: software decoders fall 15–20 × \times short of that on an Orin Nano Super, making a token 2.5–3.2 × \times slower than the same codes at fixed width.
blocks.zh: 无损失重量编码,从深压缩[6]到最近关于16位LLM重量[7,8,9,10]或一个四位体的整数[11,12]的工作,按给定的量子处理,大多在软件中解码. 一个编码的4位模型只有在质量相同的情况下击败下一个较小的固定width格式才值得使用,一个比较很少,并且只有当它的代码可以按每个符号的DRAM速率扩展:软件解码器在Orin Nano Super上跌落15–20×\时差,使得一个符号2.5–3.2×\时差于固定宽度的同一代码.

blocks.en: LazyWeights removes the commitment end to end (Fig. 1 ). It shapes the codes inside the deployed format, codes them with a Huffman layout built for parallel decoding, and decodes them in a small unit between DRAM and L2, where bytes are counted. The GPU still reads fixed-width codes, so its kernels are untouched, the decoded weights are bit-identical to a valid GGUF file, and quality is the quantizer’s alone. On the bandwidth-bound Orin, fewer bytes then mean faster, cheaper tokens; on the instruction- and capacity-bound Nano, the unit removes software decoding and the coded size decides whether Mistral-7B runs at all (Table I ).
blocks.zh: LazyWights删除承诺结束(图1). 它会塑造部署格式内部的代码,用为平行解码而构建的Huffman布局来编码,并在DRAM和L2之间的一个小单元中解码,其中的字节被计算在内. GPU仍然读取固定的宽码,因此其内核没有被触动,解码的权重与有效的GGUF文件是位同的,质量是四位体独有的. 在带宽的Orin上,少字节意味着更快,更便宜的代号;在指令和容量的Nano上,单元去除软件解码,编码大小决定Mistral-7B是否运行(表一).

blocks.en: Our contributions: • Entropy-aware quantization in standard formats : GPTQ with shared sub-block steps and a wider step, emitting valid GGUF 5.7–31.4% smaller than the best llama.cpp format at ≤ \leq 1% and ≤ \leq 3.5% Δ \Delta PPL. • A parallel-decodable Huffman bundle : a length-limited canonical code per matrix, 32 interleaved lane streams per tile, pair symbols for 4-bit codes; within 1.2–2.1% of the zeroth-order entropy, all overheads included. • A Huffman decode unit between DRAM and L2 : 0.05 mm 2 per 32-lane engine at 1 GHz (ASAP7), sized from the bandwidth, bit-exact, prototyped on an AMD ZCU102; never larger than rANS in rate, smaller in area at equal throughput. • End-to-end evaluation in two edge regimes : latency and energy per token on a Jetson Orin Nano Super and a Jetson Nano, greedy and with prompt-lookup speculation, against llama.cpp , from measured time, energy and DRAM energy per byte and synthesized decoder power.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Weight quantization. GPTQ [ 2 ] quantizes column by column, feeding each column’s Hessian-weighted error into the rest; AWQ [ 3 ] rescales salient channels. Both target fixed-width formats, like llama.cpp ’s [ 1 ] K- and I-quants (optionally with an importance matrix), which edge models ship in and which are our baseline. AQLM [ 13 ] , QuIP# [ 14 ] and QTIP [ 15 ] reach lower rates at equal quality with vector and trellis codebooks but need their own formats and kernels; we keep the deployed scalar format and code its integers.
blocks.zh: 体重量化. GPTQ [2] 将纵列按纵列进行量化,将每个纵列的黑森加权误差输入其余部分; AWQ [3] 重新测定显著通道. 两种目标固定宽度格式,如 lama.cpp 的 [1] K 和 I-quants(可选用重要矩阵), 其边缘模型是我们的基线。 AQLM [13], QuIP# [14] 和 QTIP [15] 在质量上与矢量和trellis 编码本达到较低的速率,但需要它们自己的格式和内核;我们保留部署的scalar格式并编码其整数.

blocks.en: Entropy-constrained quantization. ECSQ adds a rate term to the distortion; Choi et al. [ 16 ] applied Hessian-weighted ECSQ to network weights. Inside GPTQ, structural changes to the grid matter far more than this term (§ VII ).
blocks.zh: 内经紧固量化. ECSQ在扭曲中增加了一个比率词;Choi等人。 [16]将黑森加权ECSQ应用于网络加权. 在GPTQ内部,网格的结构变化比这个术语重要得多(§VII).

blocks.en: Lossless coding of weights. Deep Compression [ 6 ] Huffman-coded the cluster indices of pruned CNNs; DeepCABAC [ 17 ] arithmetic-codes weights for storage and transmission. For LLMs, ZipNN [ 8 ] compresses model files for storage and transfer, DFloat11 [ 7 ] entropy-codes BF16 exponents and decodes them in a GPU kernel, ZipServ [ 9 ] fuses a fixed-length bitmap encoding of BF16 into the Tensor-Core GEMM, and Huff-LLM [ 10 ] Huffman-codes 16-bit weights end to end; all keep roughly 70% of the BF16 size, around 11 bits per weight, well above what edge devices deploy. EntroLLM [ 11 ] codes tensor-level 8- and 4-bit integers and decodes them in parallel on a Jetson’s CPU.
blocks.zh: 减值编码重量。 深压缩 [6] 赫夫曼-编码了被打压的CNN的集群指数; DeepCABAC [17] 算术-编码权重用于存储和传输. 对于LLMS,ZipNN [8] 压缩用于存储和传输的模型文件,DFloat11 [7] entropy-code BF16 expents并解码到一个GPU内核中,ZipServ [9] 将BF16的固定长度位图编码导入Tensor-Core GEMM中,Huff-LLM [10] Huffman-code 16-bit 重量结束;所有都保持大约70%的BF16大小,每重量约11位,远高于边设备部署的位置. EntroLLM [11] 代码为拉索级8位和4位整数,并在Jetson的CPU上平行解码.

blocks.en: Entropy decoders in hardware. Huffman decoding runs in FPGA Deflate cores [ 18 ] and in parallel on GPUs [ 19 ] ; ANS/rANS [ 20 ] reaches arithmetic-coding rates but has a multiply in its state recurrence. APack [ 21 ] places an arithmetic decoder next to a DNN accelerator’s memory controller; we place a Huffman unit there in a GPU memory hierarchy, size it from the bandwidth, and compare it with rANS at equal throughput.
blocks.zh: 硬件中的Entropy解码器. Huffman解码在FPGA Deflate核心[18]中运行,并平行在GPU[19]上运行;ANS/rANS[20]达到算术-编码速率,但其重现状态有倍增. APack [21] 在 DNN 加速器的内存控制器旁边放置一个算术解码器; 我们把一个Huffman 单元放在 GPU 内存结构中, 从带宽上大小, 并将其与 RANS 相同吞吐量比较.

blocks.en: Low-bit runtimes. BitLLM [ 22 ] speeds up fixed-width low-bit decoding on mobile GPUs (KV-cache layouts, packing, deferred type conversion); it cuts compute per code, we cut bytes per code, so the two compose.
blocks.zh: 低位运行时间. BitLLM[22]在移动GPU上加速固定-width低位解码(KV-cache布局,包装,推迟类型转换);它削减了每个代码的计算,我们削减每个代码的字节,所以两个编程.

blocks.en: Where we sit. LazyWeights is, to our knowledge, the first design to code the deployed integer format rather than merely store it: it shapes the codes inside llama.cpp ’s formats, keeps files valid GGUF, decodes in hardware where DRAM traffic is counted, and compares against the best fixed-width format at equal perplexity, the comparison that decides whether coding is worth its decoder. Any quantizer that emits integer codes in a fixed format can feed the bundle and the unit.
blocks.zh: 我们坐的地方。 据我们所知,LazyWights是第一个编码所部署的整数格式的设计,而不是仅仅存储它:它塑造在lama.cpp格式内的代码,将文件有效GGUF保存,在计算DRAM流量的硬件中解码,在同样复杂的情况下与最好的固定wids格式进行比较,这种比较决定编码是否值得它的解码器. 任何以固定格式输出整数代码的量子可以输入捆绑和单位.

blocks.en: IV-C A lossless Huffman bundle built for parallel decoding

blocks.en: Fig. 3: (a) Bundle layout: a 64 × 256 64\times 256 tile of 4-bit codes is 32 lanes of two rows; each lane is one Huffman stream of 32-bit words (code boundaries illustrative); the lanes’ words are interleaved, so one aligned read fetches the next word of every lane, and per-tile lane offsets let any tile start independently; two 4-bit codes form one 8-bit pair symbol. (b) Decode unit between the memory controller and L2 (as in Fig. 1 ): T T engines of 32 lanes sharing an 8-word read port through a masked round-robin arbiter; a lane compares an 11-bit peek against per-length limits (no 2048-entry table), adds the length’s offset to index the symbol table, and shifts its buffer by the length.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) Bundle布局:64×256 64\times 256瓦的4位码为32道两排;每条车道为一条Huffman溪流,32位字(代码边界说明);车道的单词互开,所以一个对齐读取每个车道的下一字,每条车道抵消让任何瓦片独立开始;两个4位码组成一个8位对符号. (b) 内存控制器与L2之间的解码单元(如图1):32道的T型发动机共用一个8字读端口,通过蒙面圆形仲裁器;一条道比照每长限度(无2048-入口表)进行11位的偷看,将长度的抵消加入符号表索引,并按长度调整其缓冲。

blocks.en: Huffman decoding is sequential: a code’s start is known only once the previous code is decoded. The bundle (Fig. 3 a) breaks this. Each matrix has one canonical code, length-limited to 11 bits so an 11-bit window always resolves a code. Each 64 × 256 64\times 256 tile is 32 lane streams of two rows, decoded in parallel without waiting for each other. The lanes’ 32-bit words are interleaved, so the words needed next are adjacent and a GPU warp or the unit’s read port fetches them in wide, aligned reads; per-tile lane offsets let any tile start independently. In 4-bit formats two codes form one 8-bit pair symbol , two weights per decode step.
blocks.zh: Huffman 解码是相继的:一个代码的开始只有在前一个代码解码后才能知道. 捆绑(图3a)打破了这一点。 每个矩阵都有一个条形码,长度限制为11位,所以11位窗口总是解决一个代码. 每块64×256 64\times 256瓦为两排的32条车道溪流,平行解码,不互相等待. 车道的32位单词互换,所以接下来需要的单词是相邻的,一个GPU曲面或单位读端口会以宽的,对齐的读取它们;每片的单词相抵让任何瓦片独立启动. 在4位格式中,两个代码组成一个8位对偶符号,每个解码步骤有两个权重.

blocks.en: IV-D A Huffman decode unit between DRAM and L2
blocks.zh: DRAM和L2之间的IV-D A Huffman解码单元

blocks.en: Decoding in the GPU kernels spends instructions on bit manipulation, costing more time than the bytes save; expanding weights back into DRAM saves storage, not bandwidth. LazyWeights decodes between the memory controller and L2 (Fig. 3 b): DRAM holds and moves only coded weights, L2 receives fixed-width codes, and the kernel is unchanged, so the first term of ( 1 ) follows the coded size.
blocks.zh: 在GPU内核中解码会将指令用在比特操作上,花费比字节保存更多的时间;将权重扩大回DRAM保存存储,而不是带宽. LazyWights在内存控制器和L2(图3b)之间解码: DRAM只持有并移动编码的重量,L2接收固定的宽码,内核不变,因此(1)的第一个术语遵循编码大小.

blocks.en: Lane. A request side feeds the lane’s stream through a 4-entry prefetch FIFO into a 64-bit bit buffer. The next 11 bits are compared against 11 per-length limits at once; the thermometer result gives the length, the symbol is the code plus a per-length offset, and the buffer shifts. A lane emits one pair symbol (two weights) per cycle; the per-matrix limit and offset tables are broadcast by the engine.
blocks.zh: 莱恩 请求方通过4进前的 FIFO 向车道的溪流输入64位位缓冲器 。 接下来的11位被一次比作11个每长限制;温度计结果给出长度,符号是代码加每长偏移,缓冲变化. 车道每个周期发出一对符号(两个重量);每个车次的限制和抵消表由发动机广播.

blocks.en: Engine. 32 lanes share an 8-word read port through a masked round-robin arbiter, decoding 31.9 symbols per cycle (0.2% stall), i.e. 60–64 weights per cycle for pair-coded formats.
blocks.zh: 发动机 32道通过蒙面圆形圆形仲裁器共享一个8字读端口,每个周期(0.2%的摊位)解码31.9个符号,即对成对编码格式的每周期60~64个重量.

blocks.en: Sizing and clock. To keep pace with DRAM, the unit must decode θ ∗ = 8 ​ β b c \theta^{*}=\frac{8\beta}{b_{c}} (5) weights per second ( b c b_{c} : coded bits per weight), 151–229 G weights/s at 102 GB/s. At 1 GHz, close to the Orin’s 1.02 GHz GPU clock (MAXN_SUPER), four engines (0.206 mm 2 ) cover θ ∗ \theta^{*} for five of six points; SmolLM ≤ \leq 1%, whose 5- and 6-bit codes decode singly (32 weights per cycle per engine), needs five (0.258 mm 2 ). Lower clocks need proportionally more engines; the Nano needs 1–2. The lane’s compare-and-shift recurrence closes 1 GHz without the repair the arbiter needs, while a 2048-entry lookup table per lane is 9 × \times larger and misses it (Table V ).

Verification. A C model reproduces every coded matrix of 17 bundles with zero mismatches; Verilator co-simulation of the SystemVerilog RTL is bit- and cycle-exact against it on 29/29 matrices in 5 configurations; and N N engines against a bandwidth-capped DRAM model with read latencies up to 1024 cycles are bit-exact on all 6 points at 95–96% of θ ∗ \theta^{*} . Synthesis: Yosys/ABC, OpenROAD, OpenSTA, ASAP7 RVT TT, logic synthesis (pre-layout).

blocks.en: FPGA prototype. We map four engines onto an AMD ZCU102: a Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU9EG MPSoC (speed grade − - 2; 274k LUTs, 548k flip-flops, 32.1 Mb of block RAM, 2,520 DSP slices) with a quad-core 1.2 GHz Arm Cortex-A53 running Linux, 4 GB of 64-bit DDR4 on the processor side and 512 MB of 16-bit DDR4 on the fabric side. The Arm cores write each matrix’s bundle in chunks into block RAM over AXI and start the engines together; every lane’s output (CRC-32) and every chunk’s cycle, stall and word counts are checked against the C model.
blocks.zh: FPGA原型机. 我们将四台发动机映射到AMD ZCU102上:一台Zynq Ultra Scale+XCZU9EG MPSoC(速度等级− - 2;274k LUTs,548k翻转浮点数,32.1) Mb of block RAM, 2,520 DSP切片),四核1.2 GHz Arm Cortex-A53运行Linux,处理器侧4GB为64位DDR4,织物侧512MB为16位DDR4. Arm核心将每个矩阵的捆绑成块,在AXI上编成块内存,并一起启动发动机;每个车道的输出(CRC-32)和每个块的循环,摊位和字数都与C型号核对.

blocks.en: Our runtime runs both the twin – the same codes without entropy coding, as the GPU sees them behind the unit – and the coded bundle, decoded inside the GEMV kernels as the software reference. A fixed-order reduction across tile columns, in the int8 and fp32 kernels, makes the two bit-identical, so losslessness is tested end to end: identical logits on both devices, and speculation (up to 8 tokens per pass) token-identical to greedy.
blocks.zh: 我们的运行时间既运行双胞胎 — 相同的代码, 而不使用entropy编码, 正如GPU在单元后面看到的 — 以及编码的捆绑, 在GEMV内核内部解码为软件参考. 在整数内核的整数和fp32内核中,对瓦片柱的固定顺序进行削减,使两个位点相同,因此失落被测试为结束:两个设备上相同的对数,以及猜测(每通过最多8个令牌)的同位符-贪婪.

blocks.en: Speculation. Attention reads each key and value once for all draft tokens of a head, with per-query arithmetic independent of the draft length, and Q5_K/Q6_K twins keep the GGUF width (nibbles plus a high-bit plane), not bytes (Table II ).
blocks.zh: 投机. 注意读出每个键和值一次一个头的所有草稿符号,每格算法独立于草稿长度,Q5_K/Q6_K双胞胎保留GGUF宽度(nibbles加一个高位平面),而不是字节(表二).

blocks.en: Nano kernels. The instruction-bound Nano needs few instructions per weight. A 32-bit fetch yields four (5/6-bit) or eight (4-bit) fixed-width codes; Q5_K/Q6_K codes are rebuilt from their nibble and high-bit planes by byte permutes, one sub-block per fetch. Byte permutes also replace integer-to-float conversion (a code placed under the exponent of 2 23 2^{23} , recovered by one subtraction) and table lookup (the 16 IQ4_XS grid values, biased to unsigned bytes); the multiply-add order is unchanged. The ordered reduction replaces Maxwell’s slow global atomics.
blocks.zh: 纳诺内核. 受指令约束的纳诺每重量不需要指令. 一个32位的获取生成4个(5/6位)或8个(4位)的固定width代码;Q5_K/Q6_K代码从他们的硝化和高位平面中重建出byte permute,每个获取一个子块. 字节永久值还取代整数到浮点转换(一个代码置于2 23 2^{23}的指数下,用一个减法恢复)和表格检索(16 IQ4_XS格值,偏向无符号字节);乘法加序不变. 校对:Soup

blocks.en: CUDA graphs. Each kernel launch idles the GPU for about 4 μ \mu s. We replay each pass shape (1–8 tokens) as a CUDA graph, with the position read from device memory, with bit-identical logits on all 14 bundles; llama.cpp already uses graphs on the Orin.
blocks.zh: CUDA图. 每个内核发射都闲置GPU约4μ\mu s. 我们以 CUDA 图表的形式重放每个通过形状(1–8 个令牌), 位置从设备内存中读取, 所有 14 捆绑上都有比特- 相同的对数; lama.cpp 已经在 Orin 上使用图表 。

blocks.en: Streaming on a 4 GB device. The Nano has 3.6 GB free at idle; CUDA takes about 200 MB, and we keep 384 MiB free because an out-of-memory kill takes down system services. Tegra device memory is pinned host memory and counts against that floor, so at most 2.56 GB of weights stay resident, while the Mistral-7B bundles are 3.2–3.6 GB. The rest is streamed every pass in forward order: stored pre-interleaved in the device layout (4096-byte aligned) and read with O_DIRECT by a loader thread into two pinned staging buffers, overlapping I/O and compute. Streamed tokens equal resident ones.
blocks.zh: 4GB设备上流. Nano在闲置时有3.6GB自由;CUDA需要约200MB,我们保留384MiB自由,因为一个超模的杀机会破坏系统服务. Tegra设备内存是固定主机内存,与该层相对,因此最多2.56 GB的权重仍为常住,而Mistral-7B捆绑则为3.2–3.6 GB. 其余的每段按前进顺序流出:存储在设备布局(4096字节对齐)中,与O_DIRECT通过加载器线程读入两个固定的中转缓冲器,重叠I/O并计算. 流出的象征物与居民一样

blocks.en: Baselines. On the Orin the budget baseline uses llama.cpp ’s CUDA kernels. The Nano is frozen at CUDA 10.2 and gcc 7.5 (its last JetPack): current llama.cpp no longer builds its CUDA backend there, and releases that do predate the I-quants (IQ4_XS, IQ3_M) several baselines use, so the Nano baseline is current llama.cpp cross-compiled for the 4-core CPU, the best llama.cpp available. Our runtime builds for sm_53 with fp32 activations. The fixed-width twin isolates the unit’s share with identical kernels; other runtimes (MLC-LLM, TensorRT-LLM) alter only the kernel share.

blocks.en: VI-B Latency and energy on the Orin Nano Super
blocks.zh: Orin Nano超级赛的Latency和能量

blocks.en: With the unit, every greedy point beats the budget baseline by 10–36% in time (up to 44% bandwidth-bound) and 9–38% in energy (Table III ); the decoder costs 3–13 mJ per token against 5–61 mJ of DRAM energy saved, and with always-on engines at 2 × \times power energy still drops 6–36% greedy and 17–42% with speculation. Without the unit, coding would slow the Orin down (§ I , Fig. 5 b).
blocks.zh: 有了这个单位,每个贪婪点都会及时将预算基线比10-36 % ( 最多44%带宽) 和9-38 % (表三 ) ; 解码器的成本是3-13 mJ每令令令值,而所节省的DRAM能量是5-61 mJ, 并且总在2×xx时间的引擎仍然会减少6-36 % 的贪婪和17-42 % 的投机。 没有这个单位,编码会让奥林号减速(§I,图5b).

blocks.en: Speculation composes with the unit: it cuts passes per token, the unit cuts bytes per pass. Against llama.cpp with speculation, every point is 29–54% faster (up to 57% bandwidth-bound) at 21–44% less energy. One change at a time (Fig. 5 a), speculation is the largest step on the Orin (1.3–2.0 × \times ), the format gives 1.3–1.4 × \times where it changes the file, and the drafter is within 5%: ours accepts more tokens per pass (1.96 vs 1.63 on Mistral), but larger passes cost more.

blocks.en: For resident models (Table IV ), LazyWeights with the unit takes 58–64% less time and 53–57% less energy per token than llama.cpp on the CPU, greedy, and 70–76% less time and 69–76% less energy with speculation in both. Most of this comes from the GPU kernels (Fig. 5 a, bottom), as Table I predicts, but the unit matters: software decoding is 2.2–3.2 × \times slower than the twin and beats the CPU only on Phi-3 and SmolLM ≤ \leq 3.5% (by 9–20%), not on SmolLM ≤ \leq 1%, whose 5/6-bit codes decode singly. With the Nano’s low DRAM energy per byte, energy with the unit is within ± \pm 0.03 J of the measured twin energy. Speculation helps our GPU runtime (SmolLM ≤ \leq 3.5% twin − - 25%; Phi-3 only − - 7 to − - 9%, as an 8-token pass costs 3.6 × \times a 1-token pass) and hurts llama.cpp on the instruction-bound CPU by 28–32%.

blocks.en: Mistral-7B, streamed. Here the coded size decides: at ≤ \leq 1%, LazyWeights is 6.6 × \times faster than llama.cpp at 4.5 × \times less energy, even decoding in software. At ≤ \leq 3.5%, llama.cpp wins greedy time narrowly at more energy and LazyWeights wins with speculation, because llama.cpp ’s memory-mapped IQ3_M file (3.28 GB) stays in the reclaimable page cache, which does not count against our floor. A slightly larger file gets almost no hits, since every token scans the weights in the same order: our IQ4_XS GGUF (3.91 GB) takes 15.1 s. Our bundle (3.18 GB) is smaller still, but the cache cannot hold its streamed matrices beside our pinned resident weights and the kernel’s 464 MB CMA reservation, hence O_DIRECT. A pass costs about 1.0 s of compute plus the streamed bytes, and about the same for 1 or 8 tokens, so accepted tokens per pass set speculation’s gain; a USB 3 stick (317 MB/s) instead of the SD card (70 MB/s) cuts our software-decoding token time 2.1–2.7 × \times .
blocks.zh: 迷雾7B,流传。 这里的编码大小决定:在\leq 1%时,LazyWights比 lama.cpp 更快,在4.5 ×\times 能量减少,甚至在软件中解码. 在 \leq 3.5% 时, lama. cpp 以更多的能量赢得贪婪的时间, LazyWights 以投机取胜, 因为 lama. cpp 的内存缩放 IQ3_M 文件( 3.28 GB ) 仍保留在可回收页面缓存中, 一个稍大的文件得到几乎没有点击,因为每个令牌都以相同的顺序扫描权重:我们的IQ4QQS GGUF(3.91 GB)需要15.1 s. 我们的捆绑(3.18 GB)仍然较小,但缓存无法在固定的常住重量和内核的464 MB CMA预留量(O_DIRECT)之外保持其流式矩阵。 大约1.0 s 的运算加上流线字节, 而1或8个符的运算则大致相同, 所以每个运算符的运算值为投机收益; USB 3 棒( 317 MB/s) 而非 SD 卡( 70 MB/s) 削减了我们的软件解码符时间2.1–2.7 ×x时间 。

blocks.en: Huffman outperforms rANS on both axes. Rate: rANS is never smaller (0.0 to +1.0% more bits): Huffman is already within 1.2–2.1% of entropy, and rANS pays 32 bits of state plus padding per lane stream. Hardware: at equal throughput (2 G weights/s), rANS needs 4.0 × \times the area with pair symbols (270 MHz) or 1.15 × \times with single codes (645 MHz), as its one-cycle recurrence holds a symbol search, a table select and a 13 × \times 20-bit multiply against Huffman’s compare and shift. Interleaving several rANS states per lane would relax its recurrence; we did not evaluate it.

blocks.en: VI-E FPGA prototype
blocks.zh: VI-E FPGA原型车

blocks.en: On the ZCU102, four engines close timing at 112.5 MHz (WNS +0.06 ns; the decode-to-arbiter loop caps the design near 115 MHz) using 183.0k LUTs (67%), 37.2k flip-flops, 464 BRAM36 (51%, mostly payload copies) and no DSPs: 46k LUTs and 116 BRAM36 per engine. All 29 matrices (2,723 chunks, 484M weights) decode bit-exact, with cycle, stall and word counts equal to the C model on every chunk. Each engine sustains 31.8 weights per cycle, 14.3 G weights/s for four; the fabric (VCCINT) draws 0.88 W idle plus 3.7 W at full rate, 0.26 nJ per weight.

blocks.en: VIII Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八. 限制和结论

blocks.en: The unit’s latency and energy are projections from measured device numbers and pre-layout synthesis, not a fabricated SoC; the FPGA shows bit- and cycle-exact decoding, but at FPGA clocks, not 1 GHz. For streamed Mistral-7B the twin is no proxy for the unit: it streams the fixed-width bytes (1.05 GB per token at a 2560 MB budget vs 0.68/0.26 GB coded at ≤ \leq 1%/ ≤ \leq 3.5%), leaves less than our memory floor free, and at a 2048 MB budget from the SD card was 1.2–1.8 × \times slower than software decoding. We therefore do not report the unit’s streaming time; reading its coded bytes alone takes 2.2/0.8 s per token from USB. We did not evaluate Llama-3 or Qwen3, which quantize worse [ 23 ] , or long contexts, where the uncoded fp16 KV cache dilutes the saving (Mistral-7B at 4K tokens: 0.54 GB per pass vs 3.5 GB of weights).
blocks.zh: 单位的耐用性和能量是来自测量的装置编号和预放式合成的预测,而不是一种编造的SoC;FPGA显示位码和周期精确的解码,而是在FPGA时钟,而不是1GHz. 对于流化的Mistral-7B,双胞胎不是该单元的代名词:它流出固定的width字节数(按2560 MB预算计算,每个字节为1.05 GB,对0.68/0.26 GB编码为 \leq 1%/\leq 3.5%),留下的比我们的内存地板免费少,在2048 MB的预算中,SD卡比软件解码慢1.2–1.8x\时间. 因此,我们不报告该单位的流线时间;单读其编码的字节就每个字节需要USB的2.2/0.8s。 我们没有评价Llama-3或Qune3,它们将更糟糕的[23],或长的上下文,其中未编码的fp16 KV缓存稀释了保存(Mistral-7B在4K令牌上:每过关0.54GB对3.5GB的权重).

blocks.en: The fixed width of edge LLM formats is a commitment, not a necessity: the codes are far from uniform, the quantizer can make them less so at no quality cost, and an entropy coder removes the difference if the decoder sits where bytes are counted. Shaped and Huffman-coded, models in llama.cpp ’s formats are 5.7–31.4% smaller at equal perplexity; a 0.2 mm 2 unit between DRAM and L2 turns this into faster, cheaper tokens on a bandwidth-bound Orin Nano Super, with or without speculation, and lets a capacity-bound Nano run a 7B model that otherwise does not fit. Coding the KV cache, newer model families, and a layout next to a real memory controller are independent next steps.
blocks.zh: 边缘LLM格式的固定宽度是一个承诺,而不是一个必要:代码远非统一,四解码器可以不花费质量成本而降低它们,如果解码器坐落在字节数的位置,则一个 en码器可以消除差异. 成形和Huffman编码,在lama.cpp的格式中,模型在同样复杂度下小于5.7–31.4 %;DRAM和L2之间的0.2毫米2单位在带宽带宽的Orin Nano Super上将它变成更快,更便宜的代币,无论有无猜测,让容量带宽的Nano运行一个原本不适合的7B模型. 编码 KV 缓存, 较新的模型家族, 以及一个真正的内存控制器旁边的布局, 是独立的下一步 。
